# Diamond review — 2026-09-22

Scope: merged `f7617fadf78bb0e559e9322166704e49329a0f7b`, with corrective
code at `923b556d57185c55b8ee188abdbed9bcc76af89b`. This is a bounded defensive
review and regression run, not certification of the whole system.

## Corrections

- Kira now binds receipt, Aura-entry and reconstructed record content digests
  before optional stored-object reads. Supplying a store adds evidence instead
  of dropping the receipt-to-content comparison.
- Diamond, its foreign smoke verifier and Kira reject noncanonical and small-order
  Ed25519 point encodings. Official valid vectors remain accepted. The frozen
  Alpha source snapshot was not rewritten or represented as re-audited crypto.
- Alpha legacy v2 reconstructs configuration bytes in the preserved producer's
  fixed field order. Its synthetic fixture now uses that order and the real
  preserved policy digest. This remains synthetic v2 evidence.

Controls exercise honest producer fixtures, mismatched supplied-data relationships,
point decoding and producer encoding order. No new runtime or authority path was
introduced. A separate agent reviewed the final source diff and found no blocking
issue within this scope; that is supplementary review, not an external audit.

## Presentation, licensing and preservation

The README now separates cold consumers from the historical authority demo.
The architecture graphic is self-contained SVG with accessible title/description.
Documentation links and XML were checked; the image was rendered and visually
inspected. A bounded tracked-file scan found no conventional build junk or PEM
private-key markers. Public fixtures and fixed test seeds remain deliberately
preserved; this scan is not a comprehensive history or secret audit.

The owner explicitly licensed the AUKORA-owned Alpha copies in Diamond under
AGPL-3.0-or-later. [NOTICE](../NOTICE.md) and the
[Alpha grant](../profiles/alpha/NOTICE.md) record this. Original pinned source

(SHA-256 `0d96a4ff68ad6d4b6f1f30f713b18d5184912ba8dd389f86aa7710db079abcb0`).

## Remaining limits

No result establishes human attendance, cell execution, host confinement,
hardware custody, global completeness or latestness. The preserved Alpha source
is a compatibility profile, not an assertion that every upstream defect is fixed.
The freeze CLI and other historical consumers are local supplied-file tools;
this review does not establish a uniform resource-exhaustion bound for arbitrary
inputs. No repository was deleted, made public, or deployed by this increment.
